subject: Caldera SIG questionnaire — evidence owners and delivery routing
messages:
From: Sarah Ng <sarah.ng@caldera.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Rourke <liam.orourke@caldera.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Caldera SIG questionnaire — initial evidence ask

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement and InfoSec at Caldera have started our vendor assurance run and sent over the SIG questionnaire (attached). A few asks up front so we can size the intake work:

- Can you confirm a primary evidence custodian for each major control domain (Access, Change Mgmt, Crypto, Logging)? We need point-of-contact names + emails we can route artifact uploads to.
- We typically require artifacts to be available for download for 90 days after delivery — are there S3/Share permissions you prefer?
- For any cryptographic key handling controls, can you provide a short architecture diagram or KMS provider + HSM details?

We'd like to get the first batch of artifacts within 7 business days if possible. I've attached the SIG file with line items we flagged as high-priority.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Ng
Senior Vendor Assurance Manager, Caldera Tech
procurement@caldera.com

Attachment: Caldera_SIG_Questionnaire_v2.xlsx (xlsx, 1 sheet)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Ng <sarah.ng@caldera.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Caldera SIG questionnaire — initial evidence ask

Hi Sarah —

Appreciate the clear priorities. We can meet the 7-business-day cadence for the first tranche. Quick plan below and a couple of clarifying Qs so we route the right people:

Plan (high level)
- We will deliver a focused packet for high-priority controls (Access, Crypto, Logging, Change Mgmt) by 2027-03-31.
- Evidence will be staged to a secure, pre-authorized S3 bucket and we'll share one-time download links; Caldera will receive a Drive manifest with direct links for each artifact.
- For anything requiring NDA or extra redaction, we'll flag it and propose a redacted view + onsite review option.

Immediate asks for Caldera:
1) Is the 90-day download window from initial delivery acceptable? We can extend retention on request but need the default documented.
2) For evidence that references customer data flows, do you need a separate attestation that redwood uses ephemeral caches only?

Internal routing (who's doing what)
- Karthik: will prepare the KMS/crypto diagram and the encrypted key handling proof statements (redwood-kms-architecture-summary.pdf).
- Jasmine: will assemble the control ownership matrix and take point on Access and Change Mgmt artifacts (control-ownership-matrix.csv).
- Marissa: will coordinate packaging, stamp evidence with metadata, and upload to the S3 manifest.

We'll send the first manifest + links to you (and procurement@caldera.com) once uploads complete.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Director, Compliance Operations | Redwood Inference

---

>

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: Sarah Ng <sarah.ng@caldera.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Caldera SIG questionnaire — initial evidence ask

Folks —

I've attached the short KMS architecture summary and a bulleted proof list for the crypto controls. Quick highlights:
- KMS provider: AWS KMS (multi-Region CMKs), HSM-backed key material (AWS CloudHSM for external-signing keys).
- Key lifecycle: automated rotation policy (90 days for CMKs used in session key wrapping), KM rotation logs retained in CloudTrail for 365 days.
- Key usage: data plane encryption uses envelope encryption; master keys never leave HSM boundary.

I'll include config snippets and the CloudTrail log sample (redacted) in the artifact packet. Jasmine — once you have the control-ownership CSV populated, I can map the crypto controls to owners.

Attachment: redwood-kms-architecture-summary.pdf (pdf, 3 pages)

-Karthik

> On Mon, 22 Mar 2027 at 11:04, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com> wrote:
> > Hi Sarah —
> >
> > Appreciate the clear priorities....

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Ng <sarah.ng@caldera.com>, procurement@caldera.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Caldera SIG questionnaire — initial evidence ask — manifest + next steps

Sarah / team —

We completed the initial evidence staging this morning. Summary and links below:

Delivery summary (items uploaded)
- Access domain: SSO config export (sso-config-20270324.json), RBAC owner matrix (control-ownership-matrix.csv).
- Crypto domain: KMS architecture summary (redwood-kms-architecture-summary.pdf), sample CloudTrail rotation logs (cloudtrail-rotation-sample.log, redacted).
- Logging & monitoring: alerting-runbooks.pdf, centralized-log-retention-policy.pdf.
- Change management: PR review checklist and deployment audit snapshots (pr-review-snapshots.zip).

How you can access the artifacts
- One-time links: https://drive.redwood.com/Caldera/Shared/SIG_evidence_folder (access controlled; expires 90 days from upload).
- HubSpot ticket: https://hubspot.com/deal/CALD-2027-1337 -> Evidence tab contains file manifest and upload timestamps.

Open items / exceptions
- A few items reference proprietary debug logs that we can only provide via redacted exports or in a controlled review. Please flag any item where you require full, unredacted logs and we will coordinate legal/NDA routing.
- We noticed two SIG questions that reference an external 3rd-party backup provider. We need confirmation if Caldera requires backups-of-backups from the vendor; if so we will treat as an exception and document compensating controls.

Next steps
- Sarah, can you confirm if the 90-day window is acceptable (default) or if procurement needs extended access?
- We propose a short review call Thursday 2027-03-25 at 10:00 PT to walk through the packet; please confirm.

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Director, Compliance Operations | Redwood Inference

Attachments: control-ownership-matrix.csv, redwood-kms-architecture-summary.pdf, pr-review-snapshots.zip

From: Liam O'Rourke <liam.orourke@caldera.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Sarah Ng <sarah.ng@caldera.com>
Cc: procurement@caldera.com, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 16:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Caldera SIG questionnaire — initial evidence ask — manifest + next steps

Mina / team —

Thanks for the prompt delivery and clear manifest. A couple quick clarifications before the review call: 

1) 90-day window is fine for now; procurement will let us know if they need a longer retention window.
2) For the items you flagged as "redacted only," we can accept redacted exports for the first pass — please include a short redaction summary (what fields were removed and why).
3) On backups-of-backups: procurement does not require vendor-to-vendor backup copies as a baseline, but they do want the compensating controls documented if you rely on a 3rd-party provider for offsite snapshots.

We confirmed the Thursday 10:00 PT call — Sarah will send a calendar invite.

Appreciate the coordination.

-Liam
Caldera Tech — Vendor Assurance
